text.EN: I'm hurt. Give me space.
text.TL: Nasaktan ako. Bigyan mo ako ng espasyo.

text.EN: Took some damage. I don't need your pity.
text.TL: May tama ako. Hindi ko kailangan ang awa mo.

text.EN: Got injured, but I'm still dangerous. Step back.
text.TL: Nasugatan ako, pero mapanganib pa rin ako. Umatras ka.

text.EN: Bleeding, but it's under control. Don't hover.
text.TL: Dumudugo, pero kontrolado ko. Huwag kang mag-aligid.

text.EN: I'm wounded. That doesn't mean I'm helpless.
text.TL: Sugatan ako. Hindi ibig sabihing wala na akong magagawa.

text.EN: I can bandage my own wounds, thank you.
text.TL: Kaya kong bendahan ang sarili kong sugat, salamat.

text.EN: It hurts, but you don't need to pry into it.
text.TL: Masakit, pero hindi mo kailangang mag-usisa.

text.EN: Just a bad cut. Keep your hands where I can see them.
text.TL: Malalim na sugat lang. Ipakita mo ang mga kamay mo.

text.EN: I'm dealing with the pain. Leave me be.
text.TL: Inaayos ko ang iniinda ko. Hayaan mo muna ako.

text.EN: Injured, yes. Vulnerable, no. Back off.
text.TL: Sugatan, oo. Mahina, hindi. Lumayo ka.

text.EN: I'm hurt, but I'm managing.
text.TL: Nasaktan ako, pero kinakaya ko.

text.EN: Took a beating earlier. Bandages are holding for now.
text.TL: Medyo napuruhan kanina. Hawak pa naman ng benda sa ngayon.

text.EN: Nursing a wound here. Trying not to reopen it.
text.TL: Inaalagaan ko ang sugat na ito. Iniiwasang bumuka ulit.

text.EN: I've been injured, but nothing that'll take me down.
text.TL: Nasugatan ako, pero hindi 'to makakapagpatumba sa akin.

text.EN: Got caught in a bad spot. Dealing with the damage.
text.TL: Naipit sa masamang sitwasyon. Tinitiis ang tinamong sugat.

text.EN: Bleeding is mostly stopped, but movement is painful.
text.TL: Karamihan sa dugo tumigil na, pero masakit kumilos.

text.EN: Stung pretty bad by an attack earlier.
text.TL: Kumikirot pa rin mula sa pag-atake kanina.

text.EN: Injuries are slowing me down, but I can keep moving.
text.TL: Pinapabagal ako ng mga sugat, pero kaya pang lumakad.

text.EN: Could use some medical supplies when we find them.
text.TL: Kailangan ko ng gamot kapag nakahanap tayo.

text.EN: I'm hurting right now, but taking it step by step.
text.TL: Masakit ang katawan ko ngayon, pero dahan-dahan lang.

text.EN: I'm hurt.
text.TL: Nasaktan ako.

text.EN: Wounded.
text.TL: Sugatan.

text.EN: Need stitches.
text.TL: Kailangan ng tahi.

text.EN: Bleeding.
text.TL: Dumudugo.

text.EN: Hurts bad.
text.TL: Sobrang sakit.

text.EN: Bandaged up.
text.TL: May benda.

text.EN: Still bleeding.
text.TL: Dumudugo pa.

text.EN: Took damage.
text.TL: Tinamaan.

text.EN: Slowed down.
text.TL: Bumagal.

text.EN: Managing pain.
text.TL: Tinitiis.

text.EN: I'm hurt, but I'm managing. Thanks for asking.
text.TL: Nasaktan ako, pero kinakaya ko. Salamat sa pagtatanong.

text.EN: Took a hit out there, but knowing you're here helps a lot.
text.TL: Tinamaan ako sa labas, pero malaking tulong na nandito ka.

text.EN: It hurts, friend, but I promise I'm holding together.
text.TL: Masakit, kaibigan, pero nangangako akong kakayanin ko.

text.EN: Got banged up a little. Thank you for your care and concern.
text.TL: Medyo napuruhan ako. Salamat sa malasakit mo.

text.EN: Nursing a wound, but seeing you safe gives me strength.
text.TL: May sugat ako, pero nagbibigay ng lakas na ligtas ka.

text.EN: I'll pull through with some rest. Thanks for checking on me.
text.TL: Makakaraos din ako kapag nakapagpahinga. Salamat sa pangangamusta.

text.EN: It's painful, but we'll patch it up together, right?
text.TL: Masakit, pero gagamutin natin ito nang magkasama, di ba?

text.EN: Appreciate the check-in. Don't worry too much about me.
text.TL: Salamat sa pagsuri. Huwag kang masyadong mag-alala sa akin.

text.EN: Got scratched up bad, but I'm glad you're by my side.
text.TL: Malala ang gasgas ko, pero masaya akong nasa tabi kita.

text.EN: Hurts like hell, but having good folks around keeps me going.
text.TL: Napakasakit, pero ang mabubuting kasama ang nagpapatuloy sa akin.
